candidate.derivedAnswer: C. Greater than or equal to 0° and less than 180°.
candidate.answerReason: The standard inclination convention is 0° ≤ α < 180°, including horizontal lines at 0°.

methods.label: Apply the inclination convention
methods.explanation: For a nonhorizontal line, the angle of inclination is measured counterclockwise from the positive direction of the \(x\)-axis to the upward direction of the line. A horizontal line is assigned an inclination of \(0^\circ\). Its range is \([0,180)\) degrees, so the answer is C.
methods.levelReason: The explanation applies the definition of inclination and explicitly handles the horizontal endpoint without introducing slope or trigonometry.
